i1.title: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette 75ml Gift Set with 70g Deodorant Stick
i1.descriptionHtml:
The cool, aromatic classic that defined fresh men's fragrance.

Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette 75ml Gift Set with 70g Deodorant Stick pairs the iconic Cool Water Eau de Toilette, first launched in 1988, with a matching deodorant stick. Mint, coriander, lavender and rosemary open with a cool, aromatic freshness, a heart of geranium, neroli, jasmine and sandalwood follows, and it settles on oakmoss, cedarwood, musk, amber and tobacco.

What's in the set

  • Cool Water Eau de Toilette 75ml (spray)
  • Cool Water Deodorant Stick 70g

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Mint, Coriander, Lavender, Rosemary, Green Notes
  • Heart: Geranium, Neroli, Jasmine, Sandalwood
  • Base: Oakmoss, Cedarwood, Musk, Amber, Tobacco

Key details

  • Brand: Davidoff
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Contents: Cool Water Eau de Toilette 75ml + Cool Water Deodorant Stick 70g
  • Scent profile: Aromatic · Aquatic · Fresh
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A cool opening of mint, coriander and lavender
  • A fresh aromatic fougère heart
  • A warm base of oakmoss, cedar, amber and musk
  • A ready-made gift with a 75ml spray

FAQ

What does Cool Water smell like?

Mint, coriander, lavender, rosemary and green notes first, then geranium, neroli, jasmine and sandalwood, finishing with oakmoss, cedarwood, musk, amber and tobacco.

What's in the set?

Cool Water Eau de Toilette 75ml (spray); Cool Water Deodorant Stick 70g.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance gift set.
